statement:
∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ < 1 ∧ ∀ (K : ℕ) (H T : ℝ), ∃ q₀ : ℕ,
      ∀ (q : ℕ), q₀ ≤ q → ∀ [NeZero q] (S : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q × ℂ)),
        (∀ p ∈ S, p.1 ≠ 1 ∧ (1/2 : ℝ) < p.2.re ∧ |p.2.im| ≤ T ∧
          p.1.LFunction p.2 = 0 ∧ (1 - p.2.re) * Real.log (q : ℝ) ≤ H) →
        let a (p : DirichletCharacter ℂ q × ℂ) : ℝ :=
          (analyticOrderNatAt p.1.LFunction p.2 : ℝ) *
            (q : ℝ) ^ ((493/100 : ℝ) * (p.2.re - 1))
        (Finset.sum S fun p => Finset.sum S fun r =>
          if (p.1 / r.1).conductor ∣ K.factorial then a p * a r else 0) ≤ θ

plain_statement.zh: 固定模数上的近 1 零点按特征分为若干类，两特征之商的导子整除 K! 时归为同一类。模数充分大时，各类加权质量的平方和有统一小于 1 的上界。
plain_statement.en: On a common modulus, put two near-1 character–zero pairs in the same class when the conductor of their quotient character divides K!. For sufficiently large moduli, the sum of squared weighted class masses has a uniform bound strictly below 1.

brief.zh: 任取 K、H、T。对同一模数 q 上非主特征与零点的有限配对集合，在实部大于 1/2、虚部绝对值至多 T、对数亏损至多 H 的窗口内，以解析重数乘 exp(−4.93(1−Re ρ)log q) 为权。对商特征导子整除 K! 的有序对求权积。由零点排斥、计数和加权尾部估计取得统一界。该界给 L-goldbach-binary-shift-exception-union 的主弧模型留下正余量。OpenAI 的 Re s > 7/8 无零点结果也推出这一命题。
brief.en: Fix K, H and T. On the common modulus q, weight each zero of a nonprincipal character in the window Re ρ > 1/2, |Im ρ| ≤ T and (1−Re ρ)log q ≤ H by its analytic multiplicity times exp(−4.93(1−Re ρ)log q). Sum the weight products over ordered pairs whose quotient character has conductor dividing K!. Combine zero repulsion, counting and weighted tail bounds. The strict upper bound leaves a positive major-arc margin for L-goldbach-binary-shift-exception-union. OpenAI’s zero-free half-plane Re s > 7/8 also implies the statement.
